pr_title: changefeedccl: per-row header support for kafka
pr_body:
Adds the `headers_json_column_name` option, usable
only with the kafka sink, which allows users to
specify a column in their table(s) of type JSONB
to be used as the kafka headers for each row.

In the future we may want this to flow into
pub/sub attributes, webhook http headers, cloud
storage tracing headers, etc.

Fixes #142106

Release note (general change): Added the
`headers_json_column_name option to the kafka
sink, allowing users to specify a column in their
table(s) of type JSONB to be used as the kafka
headers for each row.

issue_context.title: cdc/changefeeds: support metadata in kafka headers
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- We should consider solving for custom metadata in the message header for http and Kafka/Avro for a few reasons:

General trend [within](https://docs.oracle.com/en/middleware/goldengate/big-data/19.1/gadbd/using-kafka-handler.html#GUID-B3E28C32-9F7A-469E-9495-AC6D51CD6446) [cdc](https://www.striim.com/docs/en/kafka-writer.html) products to offer the ability to enrich the message header. Customers desire the ability to make their pipelines more flexible and demand for immediate context around data changes

Requirements:

- Sinks: HTTP, Kafka: Ability to pass in an arbitrary watched column into a message header (HTTP, [Kafka](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/connect/transforms/insertheader.html)) using a query option. A user should be able to configure a changefeed to capture changes from a watched table, including the field passed as part of the header:

For Kafka and HTTP it could be as simple as:
`create changefeed … with header=<header_column>`
where header_column would be a flat jsonb object with a set of kv pairs like: {X-Otel-span: 1234234, X-Otel-trace: 12312432423, …}

In the case that the user wants to exclude the header column in the changefeed message body then set the exclude_header_column flag:
`create` changefeed ... with header=<header_column>, exclude_header_column`

- [TBD] Ability to pass in a constant value into a message header (HTTP, Kafka) using a query option
`create changefeed … constHeader=<header_name>=<constant_value>`

Jira issue: CRDB-48164
